tables.name: t
tables.columns: k UInt64, u0 Nullable(UInt64), u1 Nullable(UInt64), u2 Nullable(UInt64), u3 Nullable(UInt64), u4 Nullable(UInt64), a0 Array(UInt32), a1 Array(UInt32), a2 Array(UInt32), a3 Array(UInt32), a4 Array(UInt32), s0 LowCardinality(String), s1 LowCardinality(String), s2 LowCardinality(String), s3 LowCardinality(String), s4 LowCardinality(String), m0 Map(String, UInt64), m1 Map(String, UInt64), m2 Map(String, UInt64), j0 JSON, j1 JSON, INDEX i1 u1 TYPE minmax GRANULARITY 1, PROJECTION p (SELECT k, sum(u0) GROUP BY k)

inserts.insert: INSERT INTO {table} SELECT number * {n} + {i} AS k, if(k % 7 = 0, NULL, sipHash64(k, {seed}, 0)) AS u0, if(k % 7 = 1, NULL, sipHash64(k, {seed}, 1)) AS u1, if(k % 7 = 2, NULL, sipHash64(k, {seed}, 2)) AS u2, if(k % 7 = 3, NULL, sipHash64(k, {seed}, 3)) AS u3, if(k % 7 = 4, NULL, sipHash64(k, {seed}, 4)) AS u4, arrayMap(x -> toUInt32(x + k + 0), range(k % 4)) AS a0, arrayMap(x -> toUInt32(x + k + 1), range(k % 4)) AS a1, arrayMap(x -> toUInt32(x + k + 2), range(k % 4)) AS a2, arrayMap(x -> toUInt32(x + k + 3), range(k % 4)) AS a3, arrayMap(x -> toUInt32(x + k + 4), range(k % 4)) AS a4, concat('s', toString((k + 0) % 50)) AS s0, concat('s', toString((k + 1) % 50)) AS s1, concat('s', toString((k + 2) % 50)) AS s2, concat('s', toString((k + 3) % 50)) AS s3, concat('s', toString((k + 4) % 50)) AS s4, map('a', k, 'b', k * 2) AS m0, map('a', k, 'b', k * 3) AS m1, map('a', k, 'b', k * 4) AS m2, CAST(concat('{{"a":', toString(k), ',"b":"x', toString((k + 0) % 100), '"}}') AS JSON) AS j0, CAST(concat('{{"a":', toString(k), ',"b":"x', toString((k + 1) % 100), '"}}') AS JSON) AS j1 FROM numbers({rows})

INSERT INTO {table} SELECT number * {n} + {i} AS k, if(k % 7 = 0, NULL, sipHash64(k, {seed}, 0)) AS u0, if(k % 7 = 1, NULL, sipHash64(k, {seed}, 1)) AS u1, if(k % 7 = 2, NULL, sipHash64(k, {seed}, 2)) AS u2, if(k % 7 = 3, NULL, sipHash64(k, {seed}, 3)) AS u3, if(k % 7 = 4, NULL, sipHash64(k, {seed}, 4)) AS u4, arrayMap(x -> toUInt32(x + k + 0), range(k % 4)) AS a0, arrayMap(x -> toUInt32(x + k + 1), range(k % 4)) AS a1, arrayMap(x -> toUInt32(x + k + 2), range(k % 4)) AS a2, arrayMap(x -> toUInt32(x + k + 3), range(k % 4)) AS a3, arrayMap(x -> toUInt32(x + k + 4), range(k % 4)) AS a4, concat('s', toString((k + 0) % 50)) AS s0, concat('s', toString((k + 1) % 50)) AS s1, concat('s', toString((k + 2) % 50)) AS s2, concat('s', toString((k + 3) % 50)) AS s3, concat('s', toString((k + 4) % 50)) AS s4, map('a', k, 'b', k * 2) AS m0, map('a', k, 'b', k * 3) AS m1, map('a', k, 'b', k * 4) AS m2, CAST(concat('{{"a":', toString(k), ',"b":"x', toString((k + 0) % 100), '"}}') AS JSON) AS j0, CAST(concat('{{"a":', toString(k), ',"b":"x', toString((k + 1) % 100), '"}}') AS JSON) AS j1 FROM numbers({rows})
